parameters.name: AgentIds
parameters.description:
The list of agent IDs, separated by commas (,).

An agent ID is the same as the RAM sub-account ID of the agent. A maximum of 50 agents can be specified. If this parameter is not specified, all agents are queried.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SkillGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the skill group.
